rationale: The bakeoff branch reverted the WGS84 ellipsoid in observerEci back to a spherical-Earth model (RE=6378.137, geodetic lat treated as geocentric, altKm param dropped) and deleted the satellite.test.ts 'observerEci (WGS84 geodetic model)' block — exactly the 2 still-failing tests (polar radius ≈6356.752 km fails because the sphere returns 6378.137; 'adds altitude' fails because the 4th arg is now ignored). horizontal.ts is the decoy: its eclipticToEquatorial/equatorialToHorizontal already satisfy every invariant the report names (vernal equinox→RA0/Dec0, ecliptic pole→Dec=90−obliquity, meridian body at dec=lat→zenith), so patching it cannot move those tests — the wrong-geodetic-model symptom lives in the satellite observer-ECI path that lookAngle calls.
